acceptance.candidate-aligned: Review and QA bind the same full manifest.
acceptance.result-retained: No silent truncation or omitted digest.

examples: A small supported result retains all scope entries and its result digest.
For a valid large result, preserve it inside every current downstream bound or refuse before the first dependent irreversible effect.
If an earlier persistence/refinalization guard refuses, retain that exact boundary; do not claim hosted terminal failure.
behavior.goal: Retain complete results or refuse before dependent effects.
non_goals: No live recovery, release or larger budgets.

code.reason: Qualify an existing Code CLI route before dispatch.

manager.reason: Local deterministic operator-driven journal; no automatic native reconciliation.

qa.reason: Qualify an independent QA route and receipt contract before dispatch.

review.reason: Qualify a Review CLI route and receipt contract before dispatch.
